summary: Implemented the rich_measure for Tree and rich.align.VerticalCenter feature. Changes: rich/console.py (print passes justify="default" to render options); rich/tree.py (Tree.__rich_measure__ with explicit stack, Measurement import); rich/align.py (Align width constraint to measured max, Align.__repr__, new VerticalCenter class with render, measure, repr); CHANGELOG.md (9.8.0 marked unreleased, Added subheading with two entries, existing entry kept); tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py (new repr, render, measure, width-constraint, and tree measurement tests, plus required imports). Tests were not run, per instructions; the Align width-constraint test expectation was derived by hand and is the most likely to need adjustment. Measurement tests use a default Console, so they depend on environment width.
